proof_body:
by
  intro G H _ _ _ f
  rcases (inferInstance : f.ker.Normal).eq_bot_or_eq_top with h | h
  · exact Or.inr ((MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff f).mp h)
  · left
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ f.ker := by
      rw [h]
      exact Subgroup.mem_top x
    exact hx
target_source: ∀ (G H : Type*) [Group G] [IsSimpleGroup G] [Group H] (f : G →* H), (∀ x, f x = 1) ∨ Function.Injective f
